title: Regions, December 2025 (England, generalised, clipped)
description: The nine English regions as published for December 2025. Generalised to 20 m and clipped to the coastline.

files.note: Exported from the Open Geography Portal feature service "Regions_December_2025_Boundaries_EN_BGC" (https://services1.arcgis.com/ESMARspQHYMw9BZ9/arcgis/rest/services/Regions_December_2025_Boundaries_EN_BGC/FeatureServer/0/query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=geojson), 9 features in WGS84. The portal serves this product through the API rather than as a named download, so the file is named for the layer and reproduced by rerunning that query rather than by filename.
